Build passes clean now. 0 errors, exit code 0.

Two real bugs, both from the bundler bump changing shapes underneath your code:

1. `src/core/options.js:6` — bundler now passes `{ retryCount }`, not `{ retries }`. Was crashing on `undefined.toFixed()`.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js:7` — new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`. Strict check threw on that instead of treating it as disabled.

The rest of the noise (DEP0142, DEP0198, etc.) was genuine deprecation warnings, not bugs — left as-is since they don't break anything.
